Leonard,

The card breakdown is done. The workbook is in the Q3 2025 investor reporting folder:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1eAxa-1bUj8wsfairfDDC7TDIG6enI0_I6-MH5z7OuzQ/edit
It has four tabs: By vendor, Category by month, Ledger tie-out and Q4 run-rate. Robert, I've added you for the investor update, as Leonard asked.

TIE-OUT
Every statement cycle from January to September ties to the Unreconciled operating expenses line to the cent: $97,968.21 in total. The June cycle ($12,222.02) sits in the July ledger line, as booked. Of the total, $1,000.00 is a Unity Ads charge from the August cycle. That is paid UA, so it's reclassed out of opex. That leaves $96,968.21 of non-payroll opex.

TOTALS BY GRIFFIN CATEGORY (Jan-Sep 2025 | Q3 cycles Jul-Sep)
- Software & subscriptions: $8,361.12 | $3,177.52
- Hosting & infrastructure: $27,305.36 | $14,455.70 (includes the $10,200 Unity Pro annual prepay from Aug 8)
- Research & user testing: $2,086.46 | $1,075.66

- Travel & events: $23,043.63 | $13,032.74
- Hardware & equipment: $19,203.87 | $6,295.80
- Professional & admin: $7,473.00 | $1,837.00
- Other G&A: $6,475.77 | $2,766.34
- Total: $96,968.21 | $43,660.76
Per Griffin's answers on his two open items, the GDC passes are under Marketing (non-UA) and the Unity seats are under Hosting & infrastructure.

MONTHLY RUN-RATE GOING INTO Q4: $3,326.79
This covers only vendors in that ledger line. Monthly plans are at the latest bill, annual plans at 1/12, and confirmed cancellations and downgrades are already applied.
- Software & subscriptions, $690.75: LinkedIn Sales Navigator $99.99, Sensor Tower $250.00 (Lite since Sep 5), Zapier $73.50, ChatGPT $60.00 (2 seats), Canva $45.00, DocuSign $45.00, Envato $27.04 (annual), 1Password $23.97 (3 seats from the Oct bill), Murf.ai $22.00, Buttondown $20.00, SavvyCal $16.00, Apple Developer $8.25 (annual)
- Hosting & infrastructure, $1,703.04: Unity Pro $850.00 (annual prepay), Edgegap $420.00 (Starter from the Oct 10 invoice, confirmed Sep 29), Google Cloud $396.84, Webflow $29.00, Namecheap $7.20 (annual)
- Professional & admin, $634.00: Carta $230.00 (annual), Deel $147.00, Gusto $142.00, QuickBooks $90.00, Cogency $25.00 (annual)
- Other G&A, $299.00: WeWork
Notion, AppMagic, Midjourney, Loom, Zoom, Supernormal and Backtrace are all at $0.

DISPUTED CHARGES: $60.00
- Midjourney: $60.00 posted Sep 2 on 0417, after the Jul 3 cancellation (conf MJ-77k2). It had not been refunded by the Sep 28 sheet. The Aug 2 charge was refunded on Aug 25.
Nothing else we cancelled is still billing.

Still open on the cut list:
- LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Sensor Tower: both still need cancelling. Sensor Tower is only downgraded so far.
- Zoom: the account still needs closing.

The status is in a comment on the cut list card. Arthur's still-charged items (Unity Pro, 1Password, Edgegap, Google Cloud: $1,690.81/mo) are on ENG-2370.

Best,
Fred

- **Trello:** I added a comment on the "Q4 cost cuts – card subscriptions" card. I didn't touch the checklist and didn't create a new card, as he asked.
- **Linear:** I commented on Arthur's seat cleanup ticket, ENG-2370, listing his four subscriptions still being charged: Unity Pro, 1Password, Edgegap and Google Cloud. Together they come to $1,690.81 a month.

**The numbers:**
- **Ledger total:** $97,968.21 for January to September. The ledger has no June entry, so the June statement cycle is counted in the July line, as Leonard booked it.
- **Reclass:** $1,000 of that is a Unity Ads charge from August. That's paid user acquisition, so I moved it out of opex, which leaves $96,968.21.

| Category | Total |
|---|---|

| Travel & events | $23,043.63 |
| Hardware & equipment | $19,203.87 |
| Software & subscriptions | $8,361.12 |
| Professional & admin | $7,473.00 |
| Other G&A | $6,475.77 |

The $10,200 Unity annual prepay from Aug 8 is why Hosting is the biggest category.
- **Monthly run-rate going into Q4:** $3,326.79. This already includes confirmed cuts:

**Two items on your plate:** LinkedIn Sales Navigator ($99.99 a month) is still billing, and Sensor Tower has only been downgraded, not cancelled. Both are listed under your name on the cut list. Zoom's account closure is also still open, though Zoom hasn't charged anything since May.
